tasks.title: RunMetrics through TextRun, FontRun, ShapedRun, caches, post-pass and paint
tasks.descriptionMarkdown:
**Core changes:**
- Add `RunMetrics` to `TextRun` and the resolved fields to `FontRun` and `ShapedRun`.
- Update the four merge loops, the cache keys (derived), and `fast/text.rs` `shapes_as`.
- Generalize `apply_letter_spacing_to_layout` into the per-run spacing and shift post-pass, including ascent and descent.
- Read `run.font_size` in `paint_line`.
- Make the test text systems honor run sizes: `NoopTextSystem`, `GlyphBoxTextSystem` and the text-carry `WideningTextSystem`.

**Struct literals.** Fix gpux's own `FontRun`, `ShapedRun` and `TextRun` literals, preferring `..Default::default()` where the type has a `Default`.

**Paired RayX change.** In the sibling RayX worktree (`../RayX`, branch `feature/editable-text`), make `charts/plot/label.rs`'s `TextRun` literal use `..Default::default()`.

New group `crates/gpui/tests/text_run_metrics.rs`.

tasks.title: CoreText per-run sizes on macOS and iOS
tasks.descriptionMarkdown:
**What to change, in `MacTextSystem` and `IosTextSystem`:**
- Size each run's `CTFont`.
- Map output glyph runs to input runs by string index; this must hold with the `next_up` ligature trick and with fallback fonts.
- Split merged output on size.
- Compute ascent and descent per run.

**Tests:**
- macOS: test module `run_metrics`.
- iOS: lane F check `text-run-metrics-ios` in `crates/gpux_tests_conformance/examples/ios_host/checks.rs`.

tasks.title: cosmic-text per-span sizes and the web fallback
tasks.descriptionMarkdown:
**cosmic-text:**
- Set `Attrs::metrics` per span.
- Split output runs on font and size, both in the paragraph-separator path and in the main path.

**Web text system.** Make the canvas fallback (`apply_fallback`, `run_replacements.rs`) measure and rasterize at the candidate's run size.

New test module `run_metrics` in `cosmic_text_system.rs`.

tasks.title: The rich-text-runs scene in lanes A, B, C, E and F
tasks.descriptionMarkdown:
**Scene.** Add the `rich-text-runs` conformance scene, with a new `Area` and its probes. Register it so catalog coverage stays complete.

**Paint check.** Confirm in lane C that strikethrough sits at each run's own middle and backgrounds cover the row.

tasks.title: TextAttributes spans remapped at the edit choke point
tasks.descriptionMarkdown:
**Storage.**
- Add `TextAttributes`, the span set (created on first use) and the patch API.
- Add `AttributedText` and its replace-all setter.

**Remapping.**
- Remap in `apply_buffer_edit` instead of `invalidate_style_runs`.
- Cover the rollback bypass in `rewrite_current_edit`.

New group `editable_text_attributes.rs`.

**Plain path.** Keep the splice and the cache counts for plain fields.

**Tests:**

- new scene `editable-rich-attributes` (lanes A, B and C).

tasks.title: Per-row metrics table and every geometry consumer
tasks.descriptionMarkdown:
**What to build:**
- The row table in `TextLayoutMap`: tops, heights, baselines and prefix sums.
- Move every uniform-height consumer onto it: `layout_map.rs`, `geometry.rs`, `state.rs` (vertical and page movement, reveal, auto-scroll), `element.rs` (visible rows, caret, row paint, single-line height) and `editable_text_selection_quads`.

New group `editable_text_variable_rows.rs`.

tasks.title: Per-row alignment offsets for geometry
tasks.descriptionMarkdown:
**Fix.** Compute alignment offsets per visual row with paint's function, and use them in caret, selection, hit testing and IME geometry.

**Test order.**
1. Write group `editable_text_row_alignment.rs` first.
2. Show that it fails against the old code.
3. Then fix.
